scope: Actual NetworkConfigurationFactory/Store, ServerConfigurationManager, MyXmlSerializer, NetworkManager and ApplicationHost public URL methods. Actual ConfigurationController/StartupController/MVC/auth/ForwardedHeaders/IP/BaseUrl/WebSocket middleware execute in a bounded Kestrel host. MockNetworkSettings supplies only interface inputs; credential/user and WebSocket echo gateways are controlled. No Native full server, EF, media executor, discovery or network interface binding claim.
interfaceInputPreparation: Three failure-prefix cases record raw and family-selected interface input before initial construction and exact lowercase saves. Late alias changes and other-case keys do not rebuild it. This preparation is input provenance; it is not private interface-state comparison and does not assert that an earlier failure reached interface initialization. Real OS enumeration and listener binding remain excluded.
startupInputBoundary: Actual Parser<StartupOptions>, environment configuration provider and ConvertToConfig execute for the published-server-url samples. This does not certify every unrelated startup flag. Formal main startup, PostgreSQL transfer and listener output are covered separately by the Node runtime test.
pathBoundary: The actual Kestrel/controller case uses the valid nontrailing BaseUrl ///prefix and a raw origin-form request. Raw /// XML load stability is a separate Node formal cold-read case; it does not certify whole Native boot for every BaseUrl.
coldMapBoundary: Actual ApplicationBuilder.Map registration independently records acceptance and full failure for the selected current prefixes. Node startup admission for a Native-rejected prefix is explicitly pending the Actions observation; this fixture does not assert that loading // proves a working Native application.
